results.title: Senior AI Engineer | Tech | UK
results.description:
**Join Savanta as a Senior AI Engineer and play a key role in shaping how AI powers our products, platforms and internal tools.**

 **About Us:**

  

Savanta is a leading data, market research and advisory company helping the world's leading brands make better decisions, faster. With over 500 people across offices in multiple countries, we combine deep research expertise, proprietary technology and high\-impact consulting to give our clients a complete view of their markets, their customers and their competitors.

  

Our platform gives clients access to over 100 million respondents globally, alongside a suite of intelligence products covering brand tracking, market monitoring, consumer trends, and AI\-powered insight delivery. We work with leading organisations across financial services, retail, CPG, media, technology and the public sector.

 **About the Role:**

  

This is a hands\-on opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys building production\-grade AI applications, turning complex business challenges into practical, scalable solutions. You’ll work with C\#/.NET, Azure and modern LLM technologies to create intelligent features that deliver real impact for users and the business.

  

This is an exciting opportunity to join Savanta at a time when AI is becoming a core part of both our client offering and internal technology roadmap. Your work will have visible impact quickly, with the chance to ship meaningful AI\-enabled products in short iterations, learn from real usage and continuously improve quality.

  

You’ll collaborate with product, engineering, QA, UX and business stakeholders, while also helping to raise AI engineering capability across the wider technology team through coaching, practical standards and technical leadership.

 **Some of the key areas you will work on:**

  

* Making sound engineering calls on prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, orchestration, guardrails and fallback behaviour.
* Designing LLM\-powered systems with grounding techniques like RAG, search tools and knowledge graphs.
* Defining and running LLM evaluations \- factuality, grounding, instruction following, schema adherence, safety and task success.
* Shipping AI\-powered features such as chat, summarisation, extraction, classification, workflow copilots and retrieval\-backed assistants.

  



Our Tech Team works within a learning and collaborative environment, where empowerment is key to our success, along with developing a culture of innovation and creating an environment where everyone can excel. Our development teams have a lot of autonomy in how to work day\-to\-day, with support from other roles as needed.

 **Our tech** **stack** **includes:**

  

* .NET / C\#, including APIs and backend services
* Microsoft Azure, including cloud\-native services for AI workloads
* LLM application patterns, including prompt orchestration, retrieval pipelines, and evaluation
* OpenAI\-compatible APIs / SDKs and related tooling
* GitHub / Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines
* Data platforms and storage services, including structured and unstructured data handling

  


**Please click here to view the full job description**

 **You can click here to view some more details of our work**

 **About You:**

  

We’re looking for someone who combines excellent software engineering fundamentals with strong numerical confidence, clear communication skills and the ability to work effectively with both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

  

You’ll bring strong experience in C\# and .NET, along with a proven track record of building and deploying cloud\-based applications in Azure.

  

You should have hands\-on experience delivering LLM\-powered applications in production, with a solid understanding of prompt orchestration, retrieval\-augmented generation, vector embeddings, evaluation and AI\-specific testing.

  

Experience mentoring others, improving engineering standards and balancing speed, safety, cost and quality in AI delivery will also be highly valued.

 **Essential Experience:**

  

* Strong ability in C\# and .NET building production applications and services.
* Writing and using unit tests, using any language and test framework.
* Microsoft Azure and deploying cloud\-based applications in production environments.
* Hands\-on experience implementing LLM\-driven applications beyond experimentation or demos.
* Able to explain and apply LLM evals as a core quality discipline for AI applications.
* Familiarity with OpenAI\-compatible APIs, protocols, or SDKs, and the practical considerations of integrating them into applications.
* Clear understanding of RAG and the role of vector embeddings in retrieval\-based AI systems.
* Strong understanding of software testing fundamentals, including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing, and how these differ from AI\-specific evaluation.
* Numerical confidence and working familiarity with concepts such as similarity, clustering, PCA, and basic linear algebra.
* Full product delivery mindset focused on user value, reliability, and measurable quality.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity, rapid iteration, and shifting priorities.
* Strong communication skills and ability to work effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

  


**Desirable Experience:**

  

* Using or building RAG systems in production, including retrieval tuning and relevance evaluation.
* Vector databases or Azure\-native retrieval/search services.
* Working with Snowflake or other data warehouses.
* Working with SQL Server.
* Using Azure AI services, model hosting platforms, or related observability tooling.
* Prompt management, structured output validation, tool calling, or agent\-style workflows.
* Defining evaluation datasets, benchmark suites, and regression testing pipelines for LLM applications.
* Exposure to broader ML concepts or workflows beyond LLMs.
* Mentoring other engineers and helping establish AI engineering standards.
* Security, privacy, and governance considerations for enterprise AI solutions.

  


**And in return, Savanta offers:**

  

* Salary range: £60,000 \- £70,000
* Bonus scheme
* Unlimited annual leave
* Remote Working (only required onsite 1\-2 days per month)
* Employee Assistance Program
* Flexible working practices
* Health \& wellbeing package
* Ongoing Learning \& Development
* Financial health (pension, life assurance, etc.)
* Team \& Company Socials
* Committees for Health \& Well Being, Charities \& Volunteering and DE\&I

  


**Why Join Us:**

  

The company was founded on the belief that tech should be integral to its success, and this culture of tech innovation makes us best placed to put Savanta at the heart of our clients’ businesses offering solutions before they even know the problem.

  

Part of the vibrant Next 15 Communications Group, we have an entrepreneurial and inclusive company culture that actively recognizes and values its people and offers unrivalled scope for career development, including mentoring, coaching as well as extensive training programs.

 *Savanta is committed to being an equal opportunities employer and continuously strives to be an employer of choice. Our people are our greatest asset \- we value workplace diversity and inclusion, oppose all forms of unlawful discrimination, and welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates of all backgrounds.*

 ***All candidates will be considered equally, however, unfortunately we are unable to offer visa sponsorship.***

  

We encourage authentic responses to demonstrate your experience and approach, rather than relying on Generative Al tools to write your cover letter or any questions in the application process. We may use Al Decoders as part of the review process and if answers match to a high extent that may be factored into the review.

 *For information on how Savanta uses your data, please see* https://savanta.com/about/careers/job\-opportunities

results.title: Product Manager, Fintech
results.description:
Rakuten Viber is one of the most popular and downloaded apps in the world. Working with us provides a unique opportunity to influence hundreds of millions of users and be part of the journey that makes us a true super\-app. Our mission is to make people’s lives easier by enabling meaningful connections—from sharing precious moments with family, to managing business relationships and pursuing passions. We are also rapidly expanding our ecosystem into the fintech space with Viber Pay simplifying how our global community manages and moves money.


We’re looking for an experienced, highly analytical Product Manager in the Fintech domain who can turn complex data into actionable product initiatives. You will own the strategy, roadmap and execution for how millions of users discover, activate and stick with Viber Pay / Viber’s fintech products. You will work at the intersection of product\-led growth, compliance, marketing, fraud, and legal across multiple markets. Product Managers at Viber lead all aspects of their product and drive cross\-functional teams to deliver outcomes. You will own the product backlog, UX, and feature definition, continuously striving to improve KPIs through rigorous experimentation and data analysis.


You will be part of a dedicated squad, working closely with Engineering, Data, Design, Marketing, and Support teams to prioritize development based on quantitative impact. You will be the analytical mastermind behind our top\-of\-funnel conversion, geographic expansion, and the delicate balance between a frictionless user experience and robust compliance.


We are open to candidates with experience in either onboarding/growth and cards (or one of these areas), with a strong focus on mobile user experience and data\-driven decision\-making.

* We're working in a hybrid model

  

Requirements:
  

* 7\+ years as a Product Manager in the Fintech or Consumer Payments space, with specific experience in Growth/Onboarding and/or Card products (digital wallets, or card management).
* Strong B2C Mobile App experience with a deep, quantitative understanding of mobile user behavior and UX optimization.
* Exceptional Analytical Skills: A proven track record of using product analytics platforms (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude), BI tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker), and SQL, to diagnose funnel bottlenecks , build hypotheses, run experiments, remove product friction and drive growth.
* Cross\-Functional Leadership: A strong leader with excellent interpersonal skills who can use data to build consensus and drive alignment across diverse teams.
* Communication: Fluent English with the ability to translate complex data and product concepts into clear, compelling narratives for stakeholders.

  

Responsibilities:
  

* **End\-to\-End ownership:** Drive the product lifecycle from ideation to launch for all fintech onboarding and growth initiatives. Define clear success metrics, own the KPIs, and continuously iterate based on post\-launch performance data.
* **Maximize conversion through experimentation:** Optimize the top\-of\-funnel and redesign landing pages using rigorous A/B testing, cohort analysis, and funnel tracking.
* **Eliminate friction relentlessly:** Dive deep into behavioral data and user journey mapping to identify critical UX bottlenecks, systematically streamlining data entry and collection to reduce drop\-off rates.
* **Card Lifecycle Management:** Define and manage the end\-to\-end user journey for physical and virtual cards from application and issuance to spend management and card controls.
* **Integrate compliance intelligently:** Build elegant user flows that meet strict Risk, Fraud, and KYC requirements using data to strike the perfect balance between security and seamlessness.
* **Scale globally:** Lead product readiness for new geographic markets by analysing local market data, user trends, and regional fintech behaviors.
* **Lead and inspire your squad:** Guide a dedicated team of engineers and designers, fostering a culture where product decisions are backed by data while aligning seamlessly with Support, Marketing, and Compliance.

  

Advantages:
  

* Direct experience with KYC/AML onboarding flows and driving growth for digital banking app with millions of users
* 0 to 1 consumer product experience \- you’ve built something from scratch
results.company_description: In Japanese, Rakuten stands for “optimism.” It means we are hopeful for the future and believe we can make tomorrow better by what we do today.

results.title: Senior Product Manager (B2C) - Maternity Cover - 6 month FTC
results.description:
**Who is Bridebook anyway?**  

  

Bridebook is a SaaS and Marketplace scale\-up business revolutionising the wedding industry. We are proud to be the UK’s number one wedding planning app and the ONLY global provider! Our mission is to make the wedding planning journey as happy as possible for engaged couples everywhere!  

  

With over 90% of the world’s 7\.5bn population expected to get married in their lifetime, the wedding industry is massive. It is 50% larger than the global taxi and food delivery markets combined, yet it sadly lags in digitalisation and lacks solutions for the modern\-day needs of both couples and businesses.  

  

So here's Bridebook, set to disrupt the wedding industry


Our innovative platform is designed to make wedding planning effortless and stress\-free. From personalised wedding checklists, budget management tools, a vast selection of venues and suppliers, and endless inspiration – you can access it all at your fingertips, on your mobile device! After recently becoming the first app of its kind to launch globally, Bridebook now enables couples to plan destination weddings anywhere in the world.This exciting expansion makes it a truly fantastic time to join us on our journey!


Our team is made up of talented creative, analytical, and tech\-focused minds! We’ve collaborated with some fantastic partners including the Natural History Museum, Hilton, the Ritz, Etsy and Jimmy Choo, and have been featured 12 times on the App Store as well as been rated the number 1 app by Apple. Our investors are well known for supporting some previous successful unicorns such as Airbnb, Pinterest, Skyscanner and Tesla.

**What will I be doing?** ‍‍‍‍


We’re looking for a **Senior Product Manager (B2C)** to help us redefine the wedding planning experience.


This role is all about our couples, owning and evolving the product across web and mobile to make planning a wedding feel as exciting and seamless as it should be.


You’ll lead a cross\-functional squad, balancing day\-to\-day delivery with long\-term strategy, and turning bold ideas into meaningful product experiences.


From shaping the roadmap to driving growth and engagement, your focus will be simple:  

**build a product couples can’t imagine planning without.**

**Specific responsibilities will include:**

**Vision, strategy \& roadmap**


You articulate a clear vision for the consumer product experience and translate it into a focused, outcome\-led roadmap.


You synthesise market trends, customer insights, and business goals—applying strong consumer tech product intuition (PLG loops, search \& discovery, save/favourite mechanics, conversion UX)—to define priorities and strategic bets.


You ensure alignment across stakeholders and communicate the “why” behind decisions.

**Growth, metrics \& experimentation**


 You lead OKR planning around the consumer funnel (search favourite enquiry), defining north stars, input metrics and guardrails.

* You work closely with the BI team to lead a hypothesis\-led experimentation programme: craft testable hypotheses, design A/B/n and multivariate tests, size samples and power, set success thresholds, and ensure statistical rigour and ethical standards.
* You establish and maintain product health and funnel metrics; you instrument analytics, review performance regularly, and steer decisive follow\-up actions.

**Execution \& cross\-functional delivery**

* You drive delivery with Product Design, Engineering, B2B Product, Marketing and Operations to land high\-quality releases on a predictable cadence.
* You set the priorities for your squad, make day to day decisions to support delivery, motivate and inspire them to focus on the right things in the right way at the right time.

**Customer insight \& product discovery**

* You embed qualitative and quantitative learning into decision\-making—from opportunity framing through to post\-launch.
* You engage directly with couples and venues to understand needs, validate hypotheses and de\-risk solutions early via prototypes, smoke tests and concierge experiments.
* You advocate for inclusive, accessible experiences that reduce stress and increase joy.

**People leadership \& craft**

* You model strong product craft, feedback culture and effective ways of working across the squad.
* You uplevel experimentation, discovery and communication practices across the team.
* You show strong servant leadership, driving your squad to ensuring they deliver on time and to the level of quality expected.

**We’re looking for someone who is:**

* A strategic product thinker with strong consumer tech product intuition and growth mindset.
* Data\-informed and hypothesis\-driven; comfortable with experiment design, statistical concepts and trade\-offs.
* To create joyful experiences that align with the most up to date design trends
* Empathetic advocate for couples/venues with crisp discovery and storytelling skills.
* Collaborative leader who builds trust, alignment and momentum across disciplines.
* Disciplined operator with excellent prioritisation, communication and follow\-through.

**What if you’re a partial fit?**


We love hearing from anyone who is enthusiastic about changing the wedding industry and welcome candidates with different backgrounds and experiences! We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn’t exactly match this job description.

**Benefits**


* 25 days of annual leave (pro rata)
* Hybrid Working, we’d love to see you in twice a week, but you are free to come in more often if you’d like
* Enhanced Family\-Friendly Policies
* Cycle to Work Scheme
* 2 weeks Working From Anywhere per year
* An accessible, beautiful and dog\-friendly office, with weekly breakfasts, communal lunches, alongside free snacks and more
* Yearly BB Summit and quarterly events to celebrate milestones!


Benefits are listed for a contract role


**Location**

London, Hammersmith (working hybrid, 2 days a week)

**Our Values**


One Team: Together we are better.


Keep Accelerating: We work smart.


Create Joy: We celebrate going above and beyond.

**Equal employment opportunity**


Research shows that women, neurodiverse individuals, and members of other under\-represented groups tend to not apply to jobs when they think they may not meet every qualification, when, in fact, they often do! At Bridebook we are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment and strongly encourage you to apply.

**So what’s next?**

You’ll hear from our team within 2 weeks regarding your application. We believe in efficient and meaningful conversations, so you’ll be happy to hear there isn’t a whopping 7 stage process!


That's all for now \- see you on the dancefloor!
